title: ALLSELECTED of a table inside an iteration over one of its columns: that column's filter is replaced by the iterated values, the filter on another column stays

source.quote: the filter on Color is replaced, the filter on Brand is not
source.supports: the article runs this shape (ADDCOLUMNS over ALL of the color inside CALCULATETABLE filtering color and brand, with CONCATENATEX over ALLSELECTED of the table) and states the rule; Category plays the part of Brand here

derivation: ADDCOLUMNS iterates ALL ( Product[Color] ): Blue, Green, Red, and its shadow filter context holds all three. ALLSELECTED ( Product ) restores it on Color and keeps the explicit filter Category = Accessories. Accessories of any color: Helmet (Red) and Lock (Blue), on every row.
